note.question: How does service prices and wages contribute to two platforms competing?
note.overview: In the platform economy, platforms often engage in both demand and supply competition. The model considers two platforms competing through service prices and wages. Instead of exploring myopic stability, i.e., Nash equilibrium, which focuses on the immediate payoff change from a one-step deviation, the two competing platforms are farsighted and can anticipate their rivals’ reactions.
